findings.location: ## Statement, sentence beginning “Then there is a continuous homotopy H”
findings.evidence: The statement does not say H(s,0)=f(s), nor does it state that H equals f pointwise on the asserted neighborhood of L. Proof steps 3.1 and 10.1 construct a homotopy starting at f and fixed at f there, so the statement omits part of the proved conclusion. Correcting this public statement also requires synchronizing its batch-manifest statement mirror, outside the reader's item/page write scope.

findings.location: ## Statement, clause “where SU(N) has its usual matrix Lie-group structure”
findings.evidence: The statement uses SU(N)^r and its dimensions while only naming the “usual” matrix Lie-group structure; it gives neither the exact matrix set nor its induced smooth structure and has no exact SU(N) definition among its dependencies. Step 1.1 derives these properties later, but the public statement remains incomplete. Correcting it also requires the batch-manifest statement mirror.
